title: Directed bottlenecks in the authorized observed projection
description: Rooted immediate dominators, not shortest paths, game walkability or causal/resource feasibility. Query authority and matching root/target generations are required. Supplying a target returns only its unavoidable-node chain and impact records, after complete bounded analysis. Without a target, returns the complete dominator tree. Runtime checks u64 overflow, UTF-8 byte limits, exact anchors, deadlines, work and output budgets; no partial analysis is returned.
